summary: GI round 4, package PD (date step 1), studio/gi/context.py only. Wide own-date labels in the document's head (Date seen, Case date, Exam date, Date performed, Day of procedure, and the other forms of _WIDE_DATE_LABEL) and the worded date-of-service field of D2 ('Service date logged for this case: ...') only ever ASK or NARROW, and are never sent: (a) the installed reading sends X and such a label states Y: the date is asked and only X is a member's answer (the narrow release's question, read by charge_date_problem / charge_date_own / charge_question_day, so every reader still reads X); (b) the installed reading already asks with evidence: unchanged; (c) it asks with no evidence at all (any member date taken): the labels become that evidence - one value only when a closing-role line states the same day, several values as a conflict of those values - so only dates the document states are taken. Hardening: no wide or worded label is read when sections.around_procedure_title matches (the installed fact stands); corroboration only from closing-role lines among the last 8 non-empty lines, never from a consent, order, request, booking/scheduling or call/phone line. Built so that the installed candidates - and so the installed fact - are computed exactly as installed (the wide candidates are read beside them, never among them: the prototype's joint pass let _after_another_header keep an addendum's own label 'own' when a wide label stood in the head, a possible NEW-SEND), and every other text reads byte-identically.

rule_c.binding: the cycle's binding rules: rule (c) NARROWS the accepted answers to a wide label's date ONLY when (1)-(5) below all hold; otherwise it ONLY adds the quoted evidence to the question and leaves the accepted answers as installed (every member date taken)
narrows_only_when: (1) the label's day is the AUTHOR'S OWN sign-off day: a closing-role line of the note's closing region that signs, e-signs, authenticates or finalizes the note (a dictation word beside such a verb does not disqualify it) - never a co-signature or countersignature, a transcription line, or a consent, order, request, booking, scheduling or call line; an attestation counts as the author's own sign-off ONLY when it names the performer a head field names (proceduralist, endoscopist, operator, performing physician, gastroenterologist, colonoscopist, surgeon, attending, physician, provider, seen by, author): h4-06's 'Attested:' line is its colonoscopist's own sign-off, B3's attestation by an unnamed signer is not
(2) every closing-role line after the head (co-signatures, attestations, dictation and transcription lines and every other) states that same day or no day

(3) the closing region is the note's own: its last 8 non-empty lines and never any line of the head (a short document whose head is all of it narrows nothing; the label's own line is the head's); no addendum line after the head; no line anywhere announcing copied, pasted, attached, imported, scanned, faxed, forwarded or excerpted text; the sign-off line not under a heading-like line naming another occurrence's record (sections.under_another_occurrence)

(4) the document is not around a procedure under the BROADENED detection: sections.around_procedure_title, or among the first 12 non-empty lines a title-like line or a flattened line's cell (at most 160 characters, no field value, no closing sentence punctuation) or a kind field ('Note type:', 'Encounter type:', 'Visit type:', 'Type of visit:', 'Encounter:', 'Visit:', 'Note:', ...) whose words name a booking or scheduling, pre-anything procedural (pre-procedure, pre op, pre-admission, pre-colonoscopy, ...), prep, a telephone, phone or call, a message, an appointment, a reminder, instructions, a consent, education, a handout, correspondence, a letter, a review, an outside record, nursing or a nurse, an assessment, triage, a portal, e-mail, fax, a refill, a referral, a request, an order, a cancellation, a no-show, intake, telehealth, telemedicine, a virtual or video visit
(5) exactly one candidate value: EVERY wide or worded own candidate narrows (each states the one sign-off day), never several

The live consequence for the install declaration: a pre-install encounter (its context recorded by installed, labelled gi-context@3) is re-extracted with this reader at its first member context save of ANY field (POST /context), and at any stage that remakes or re-reads its context (PX's gi-context@4 remake, Resume). (i) Rule (a) documents - installed sent the date X and a wide or worded own label in the head states another day, with no PS around-procedure title: the new context asks the date, the request differs from the run in use, and ONE new paid DATELESS primary request is sent (none when an identical dateless request was already retained); every decision whose proposal changes status (Ready for review -> Needs clarification) is invalidated with the recorded reason 'Re-assessed after changes (service date: X -> asked; ...)'. Answering X then sends nothing new (the retained dated run is reused) and returns READY, but the approval must be made again; re-saving X itself first sends nothing and carries the decision. (ii) Rule (c) narrowing documents - installed asked with no evidence, this reader takes only the label's day: a member date of another day entered before the install becomes a member-date conflict at the same moments - nothing is sent, the encounter is held with USER_CONFLICT_NOTE, decisions whose status changes are invalidated. (iii) Quote-only documents: the stored fact gains the quoted line only; no request changes, nothing is sent, member dates stay taken. Until PX bumps CONTEXT_VERSION the new context keeps the label gi-context@3 and cannot be told from an installed-made one. The live count needs the live database, which this package does not read: the install session classifies each current revision text offline with this reader ((i): installed fact 'document', this fact 'conflict' with WIDE_DATE_ASK_NOTE; (ii): a member service_date present and not the narrowed day).
